flipToBack.timing: Required after-trigger on the move event itself (TriggerConditions.movedToLocationBy), not a table-state poll
flipToBack.prose: Flip when the objective owner moves Leia to Yavin 4: War Room (move performed by playerId; any Leia, no ability constraint on the move trigger).

children.req: timing-trigger: card just moved to location by owner

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if Leia is captured.

requirementSemantics: Flip-to-back is an EVENT trigger (movedToLocationBy), not control/occupy: the move must be performed by the objective owner (playerId argument); Leia arriving via opponent action or via other means matching a different trigger type does not fire this exact condition.
Flip-to-front is an EVENT trigger (captured): fires on Leia being captured, regardless of location.
No control/occupy leaf exists anywhere in either flip law.

Both sides carry a place-out-of-play hazard: TriggerConditions.justLost(Filters.Leia) with escape hatch GameConditions.hasGameTextModification(RESCUE_THE_PRINCESS__CANNOT_BE_PLACED_OUT_OF_PLAY) and GameConditions.canBePlacedOutOfPlay (front Card7_139.java:109-122, back Card7_139_BACK.java:114-125). Front version also adds until-end-of-game MayNotDeployModifier(Filters.Death_Star_Plans) before going out of play (Card7_139.java:117-119).
typedIdentities: Filters.Leia (persona; flip actor, capture target, and out-of-play hazard)
Filters.and(Filters.Leia, Filters.abilityLessThan(4)) (setup: Leia deployed as imprisoned captive)
Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.or(Filters.spy, Filters._8D8, Filters.Revolution, Filters.Death_Star_Plans)) vs Filters.Death_Star_location (front deploy ban)

Back: Filters.or(Filters.Imperial, Filters.Dark_Jedi, Filters.Imperial_starship) (lose all immunity to attrition during battle), Filters.and(Filters.opponents(self), Filters.unique, Filters.or(Filters.character, Filters.vehicle, Filters.starship)) (lost during battle -> out of play)
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game (required, from Reserve Deck): Detention Block Corridor (Card7_139.java:53), Leia of ability < 4 deployed to Detention Block Corridor as imprisoned captive via DeployCardToTargetFromReserveDeckEffect with DeployAsCaptiveOption.deployAsImprisonedCaptive() (Card7_139.java:60), Docking Bay 327 (Card7_139.java:67), Yavin 4: Docking Bay (Card7_139.java:74), Yavin 4: War Room (Card7_139.java:81).
No objective-granted pulls/tutors on either side after setup.
otherObligations: FRONT: your spies/8D8/Revolution/Death Star Plans may not deploy to Death Star locations (Card7_139.java:95-96); Detention Block Control Room may not deploy (97); cards that release captives immune to Sense and Alter (98-99); may not play Nabrun Leids (100).

FRONT+BACK: if Leia lost from table, objective placed out of play (loss condition Rando must prevent); front adds permanent may-not-deploy Death Star Plans on the way out (Card7_139.java:109-122; Card7_139_BACK.java:114-125).

BACK: opponent must use +1 Force to initiate Force drains (InitiateForceDrainCostModifier, Card7_139_BACK.java:60); Leia participating adds one battle destiny (61); attrition against opponent +2 during battle (62); Imperials/Dark Jedi/Imperial starships lose all immunity to attrition during battle (63); opponent's unique characters/vehicles/starships lost during battle are placed out of play (97-110).

BACK ANOMALY (source fact): Card7_139_BACK.java:68-90 contains a TopLevelGameTextAction referencing game.getGameState().getSubjugatedPlanet() and Filters.matchingOperativeToSubjugatedPlanet (once-per-battle add one battle destiny). This matches no clause of the printed back game text and appears to be copy-paste from an operative objective; it is dead unless a subjugated planet exists.
